szoveg_eredeti:
Today, we’re introducing the Responses API in public preview, made for building agents on Mistral.

Each response returns the model’s answer, its reasoning and its tool calls as separate items, so your app can handle every step more easily than with Chat Completions. You can send text, images or files, stream answers and call your own tools. Many new agent tools are built only on this format, and it works with all our text models, including Mistral Large 4.

We’re also now serving two fast, low-cost models:

- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, in public preview. Great for long-context coding and agentic tasks.
- GLM 5.3 Flash, now generally available. A smaller, faster version of GLM 5.3 that costs about 9x less. Great for subagents, tool calls and coding tasks.

Served in the EU and US on Mistral AI Cloud Inference. 
Try it out today: https://lnkd.in/e2a-PBsz
